**Applied Mathematics · Scientific Computing · Scientific Machine Learning**

I am an undergraduate student in Applied and Computational Mathematics at the Federal University of Goiás (UFG), Brazil. My interests include mathematical modeling, numerical methods, optimization and uncertainty quantification.

## Selected work

- [GraphCube](https://github.com/gustavobernardo1/graphcube-lab): permutation groups, graph theory and heuristic search.
- [Mapa dos Ipês](https://github.com/gustavobernardo1/mapa-dos-ipes): citizen science and geospatial engineering.
